sections.title: Default CGM Response Format
sections.example:
21:49 | BG: 7.1 ↑ | Alarm Set: 10.0
That’s fine. 10 mmol/L is a solid ceiling — no action needed unless you hit it.

examples.response:
14:45 | BG: 7.4 → | Alarm Set: 10.0
Flat post-meal curve. No correction needed. Monitor again in 1h for delayed rise.

15:18 | BG: 10.6 ↑ | Alarm Set: 11.0
Approaching upper limit. No immediate action, but reassess in 30 min.

17:11 | BG: 4.5 ↓ | Alarm Set: 3.9
Act now — take 5–10g fast-acting carbs. Recheck in 15 min.

02:30 | BG: 4.3 → | Alarm Set: 3.9
Slightly low but stable. No action unless symptoms. Keep alarm active.

19:10 | BG: 8.9 ↑ | Alarm Set: 10.0
Let it ride unless it breaches 10+. Check again in 30–45 min.

sections.title: Meal Log Format
sections.template:
DATE: YYYY-MM-DD
TIME: HH:MM
MEAL: [description]
MACROS: [Carbs=Xg, Protein=Yg, Fat=Zg]
PRE-BG: X.X mmol/L
WAIT AFTER BOLUS: X min
MEAL TYPE TAG (MTT): [HPNC / HFHP / MMX / UL / EXP]
NOTES: [BG readings, corrections, symptoms, etc.]

entries.action: Take 15g fast-acting carbs, recheck in 15 min
20g fast-acting carbs immediately, seek help if needed
Monitor if rising, correct if no IOB
Correct + hydrate, assess for ketones if unwell
